question: Which of the following was the country in focus at the 51st International Film Festival of India held in Goa in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Bangladesh.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bangladesh was the country in focus at the 51st International Film Festival of India held in Goa in January 2021.
 
• **51st International Film Festival of India (IFF) has announced a line-up of programs that will be showcased on the Over-the-top (OTT) platform**.
 
• The festival was held in Goa from 16th to 24th January 2021.
 
• The Country in Focus is a special segment that **recognizes the cinematic excellence and contributions of the country.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bangladesh:**

 
 
• **Capital** - Dhaka.
 
• **Currency** - Bangladeshi Taka.
 
• **President** - Abdul Hamid.
 
• **Prime Minister** - Sheikh Hasina. (Feb 2022)
 
• **National Sport** - Kabaddi.
